slides.title: Layer and token geometry
claims: Pooled chemistry covers28states; token diagnostics cover8selected depths.
Rank depends strongly on layer; the256-D projected descriptive estimate does not justify uniform collapse.

slides.title: SAE feature intervention
claims: TopK code is fitted without chemical labels at raw19; reconstruction is evaluated on held-out molecules.
Subtract feature direction from ORIGINAL state, preserving residual error; separate reconstruction baseline.
Same requested amplitudes feed feature/random-feature/orthogonal-random directions; physical tokens only,CLS untouched.

slides.title: SAE reconstruction
claims: Six dictionaries: both checkpoints,k32seed0,k32seed1,k64seed0.
Greater held-out variance explained means better reconstruction under this SAE setup, not more semantic features; all fits selected the40epoch budget endpoint.

slides.title: Chemical feature associations
claims: All10frozen features per encoder retained; no amine feature qualified.
Association quality varies by concept; nitrile failures and nuisance-correlated hydroxyl features remain visible.

slides.title: Feature stability
claims: Alignment uses train-only molecule-max activations, without chemical-label remapping.
Replicated activation does not guarantee useful chemistry; features can split or share the same aligned replica.
Displayed stability points average the two frozen features per concept; no uncertainty or independent-replicate claim.

slides.title: Controlled feature effects
claims: Every feature lowers its nominated logit on average; control comparisons test dependence of frozen chemical readouts.
Only the40full-dose feature-versus-control contrasts use Holm correction; secondary CIs remain descriptive.
Requested norms match exactly; bf16 realized norms differ slightly.

slides.title: Causal influence is not chemical selectivity
claims: Latest nitrile3348 is a near-chance molecular association but still influences the nitrile logit.
Full SAE reconstruction causes downstream readout damage; higher reconstruction fidelity does not ensure chemical task preservation.

slides.title: Measured halide positive and false positive
claims: Post-confirmation illustrative extremes selected by highest test activation within positive/negative label groups.
Atoms denote molecularSMARTSlabels; physical-token activation does not assign peaks to those atoms.
